Sofia P (Finance): Quick Q — vendor 'CloudSumi' charged 20% VAT on sandbox credits (INV-2024-0827). They claim UK VAT-exempt. Need confirmation before we refund/credit. cc @Avery Legal @Marta (APAC Ops)
InvoiceBot: Invoice INV-2024-0827 attached by @CloudSumi — total £3,600 (VAT £600). File: invoice_2024_0827.pdf
Rajesh Kumar: Short checklist of acceptable proof: 1) vendor VAT registration number (confirmable on VIES/gov.uk), 2) reissued invoice showing 0% or reverse-charge statement, 3) evidence of business address outside UK + VAT ID screenshot, 4) HMRC exemption letter if charity. If none, we can't recover VAT.
Avery Legal: For B2B cross-border supplies of software the reverse charge often applies. We need the vendor's VAT reg + explicit text on invoice like: 'Reverse charge — VAT to be accounted for by the recipient.' If they're unregistered they should not have billed VAT — they must refund.
Marta (APAC Ops): Vendor just replied saying they're registered in Cyprus and pasted VAT: CY99999999. They also said it was charged automatically by their billing system.
Rajesh Kumar: I'll validate that VAT ID in VIES. If VIES confirms we ask for a reissued invoice without VAT and a short explanation. If VIES fails, request a tax residency certificate (TRC) + business registration docs.
Sofia P (Finance): Putting INV-2024-0827 on hold for now. Please request the following from vendor with 5 business day SLA: (a) VAT reg certificate or gov.uk/VIES screenshot (b) reissued invoice showing reverse charge or 0% VAT (c) short email explaining why VAT was charged.
Marta (APAC Ops): On it, sending vendor message now. Ping if you want suggested copy.
Avery Legal: Suggested vendor wording: "Please reissue the invoice showing no UK VAT and include the statement: 'Supply subject to reverse charge — UK VAT to be accounted for by the recipient.' Also attach VAT registration verification (VIES/gov.cy)."
Rajesh Kumar: Quick update — VIES lookup returned CY99999999 as valid. Once they reissue we can verify and release the hold. :white_check_mark:
Sofia P (Finance): Thanks. I'll track in the refunds sheet and only process credit after the corrected invoice is attached. Closing once credit posts. :memo:
